module.name: Live Observability Cluster Adopt
module.description: Cloud-agnostic adoption step for bnk-live-observability-foundation. Accepts plain-text kubeconfig, validates connectivity, and gates downstream modules. Does not auto-register the cluster in Forge.

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Human-readable name for the target cluster.

required.name: kubeconfig_content
required.description: Full plain-text kubeconfig for the target cluster. Sensitive.

key_outputs.name: cluster_name
key_outputs.description: The cluster name provided as input.

key_outputs.name: cluster_api_server
key_outputs.description: API server URL extracted from the kubeconfig.

key_outputs.name: adopt_ready
key_outputs.description: Gate: true once kubectl can reach the cluster API server.
